Its energy-squared curvature matrix has axis sum at most 3/2 in the stated covariant coin sectors. This is not an all-coupling speed, stability or fall theorem; finite-g corrections and other interactions remain open.

No finite response at the wave pole, nonlinear completion, lattice result or physical gravity identification is established.

findings.scope_boundary: Within the expressly supplied continuum charge equations, self-field subtraction, trace-free field-momentum constraint and no-free-wave choice: the static ledger has the stated second-order expansion and the selected moving extension gives coefficient 1/2+1/p, for p nonzero. The resulting truncated three-body Hamiltonian gives passive mass M+2a<T>+2s2<U> in the far-field, weak-binding limit. For its p=1 coefficients this equals the inertial energy through that order. This conditional calculation does not derive a nonlinear dynamical completion from the landed static or quadratic source notes. The updated head finite-cluster extension is retained only for fixed finite size with the same supplied pairwise model and virial/spectral-branch hypotheses.
